name: Conservation Awards Programme
summary: Small grants for conservation projects or research carried out by nationals or residents of Neotropical countries. Projects must directly involve globally threatened bird species or globally important sites and include local engagement or outreach.

geography.label: the Neotropics (the Caribbean, Middle America and South America)
